title: Fix Dropdown accessibility and APG keyboard behavior
description: Implement complete listbox interaction: correct combobox/listbox semantics, stable IDs and aria-controls, active option state, ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End/Enter/Space/Escape behavior, focus entry and restoration, outside-click handling, localized search/clear accessible names, and disabled/loading semantics. Add unit tests for keyboard, focus, ARIA, pointer, reactive, RTL, and loading/empty/no-results states.
acceptance_criteria: Strict reviewer finds no accessibility blockers; focused tests pass.

title: Add Dropdown Angular Forms integration and validation
description: Implement ControlValueAccessor and Validator behavior for single and multiple values, disabled state, touched/blur propagation, change propagation, and invalid state semantics. Document the forms contract and add unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: Dropdown works with reactive and template-driven forms and preserves existing model API.

title: Strict review and release validation for audit remediation
description: Review the completed remediation diff against AGENTS.md and the audit. Verify accessibility, precedence, theming, public API, tests, E2E, build, dependency changes, and final task report. Block closure on unresolved high-risk findings.
acceptance_criteria: Strict review approves and all Definition of Done checks pass.

title: Add Playwright E2E coverage for component demos
description: Add Playwright setup and one spec per demo page/component. Cover real keyboard/pointer interaction, tab order, ARIA state, focus restoration, all reachable states, RTL, light/dark mode, and computed-style theme overrides.
acceptance_criteria: npm run e2e passes against the demo app with required state assertions.

title: Complete demo state coverage
description: Update the demo so every component state is reachable: variants, sizes, disabled, loading, error/invalid where applicable, focus-visible, hover, empty, RTL, and light/dark theme. Show consumer theme and instance override examples.
acceptance_criteria: Each public component has a clear interactive state showcase.

title: Complete unit coverage for audited components
description: Expand Button, Dropdown, Badge, theme, and i18n unit tests to cover behavior, config/theme precedence, keyboard and pointer interaction, accessibility semantics/focus, reactive updates, all variants/sizes, disabled/loading/empty/error-invalid states where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Unit coverage matches every type/config state and all focused tests pass.

title: Complete theme and configuration precedence
description: Make themeable values for Button, Dropdown, and Badge follow instance override → component default → global typed config → library default. Remove hardcoded theme values from component CSS, add typed tokens for required variants, provide explicit light and dark theme CSS, and add precedence tests including per-instance CSS variable overrides.
acceptance_criteria: All three override levels work together and precedence tests pass for each component.

title: Integrate locale provider with component defaults
description: Make components consume BULUD_LOCALE where appropriate, preserve explicit instance text overrides, support English/Persian labels and direction, and test locale resolution/provider behavior without components owning the document switcher.
acceptance_criteria: Global locale config supplies defaults; instance inputs override it; RTL and accessible labels are covered.

title: §7 audit remediation
description: Resolve the component audit findings in risk order. Each child task must include focused unit coverage and required demo/E2E coverage for affected behavior.

title: Complete public API documentation and validation scripts
description: Document Badge, Dropdown, theme, i18n, forms, accessibility, typed inputs/outputs/config, usage examples, and consumer ARIA requirements. Add or restore format:check and lint scripts using existing configuration only.
acceptance_criteria: Every public API is documented and required repository checks are runnable.
